## Services

- Technical assessment of insurance and building damage
- Damage reports and evidence documentation
- Complex and large-loss claims regulation
- Cost estimate, invoice and supplemental claim review
- Storm, hail, fire, water, moisture and building-envelope damage
- Coordination of experts and documented decision foundations for insurers and other clients
